title: Xanthe and the Will
author: Zephyrine Brightwater
blurb: Tamsin Almeida, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
